svg.aria-label: How a codevira decision becomes a block: record_decision writes decisions.jsonl, a later edit is intercepted by the Claude Code PreToolUse hook, the Antigravity PreToolUse hook, or the git pre-commit hook; all three call engine dispatch, where decision_lock (priority 100) runs a warn ladder and refuses, and the refusal message carries the original decision reasoning. Commit-time enforcement has no diff envelope so the warn ladder cannot run.
svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Noto Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: How a codevira decision becomes a block
svg.desc: Five-stage flow. Stage 1 (day 0, record): record_decision(...) captures decision, context, alternatives_considered, would_re_examine_if and do_not_revert:true, appended as one JSON line to the project's .codevira/decisions.jsonl under an exclusive flock, then fsync; manifest, FTS5 and digest are updated best-effort. Stage 2 (weeks later): an agent, possibly a different AI in a different editor, edits a file the locked decision covers. Stage 3 (three enforcement surfaces across two timings): edit-time, the Claude Code PreToolUse hook (matcher Edit|Write|MultiEdit, script ~/.claude/hooks/codevira-pre_tool_use.sh) synthesizes a "--- before / --- after" diff envelope; the Antigravity PreToolUse hook in the project's .agents/hooks.json emits {"decision":"deny"} with exit code 0 and is implemented but its live trigger fidelity is unverified; Cursor, Codex and Copilot get no edit-time hook. Commit-time, .git/hooks/pre-commit runs "codevira engine pre-commit", reading before and after from "git show HEAD:file" and "git show :file" — with no diff envelope. Stage 4 (engine): all paths call dispatch(HookEvent), which filters by event type and sorts by priority descending. decision_lock, priority 100, calls signals.decisions(file, locked_only=True), reading decisions.jsonl rather than the graph, and runs a ladder: pure insertion warns, no shared salient tokens warns, an edit outside the locked symbol region warns, otherwise it blocks. anti_regression (80) and blast_radius_veto (50) handle the same event at lower priority; the first block by priority supplies the message. Because commit-time carries no proposed_diff, the warn ladder cannot run: decision_lock keeps the hard block, anti_regression allows, and blast_radius reports "(full Write)". Stage 5 (refusal): Claude Code gets exit 2, "continue": false and permissionDecision "deny"; git gets the message on stderr and exit 1, aborting the commit. The refusal message carries the original reasoning — the decision id, lock date, why, the rejected alternatives and the revisit trigger. Two full-width rails: fail-open conditions, and the kill switches.
svg.text: How a decision becomes a block

g.text: The [codevira:…] prefix is added by the
hook wirings; git writes the raw message.
Commit-time is presence-based. Without proposed_diff the
warn ladder cannot run: decision_lock keeps the hard
Merge commits are never evaluated, and only the first 40
staged text files are checked — the rest pass unreviewed.
Cursor gets no hooks. Codex and Copilot get nothing at all —
their whole integration is the generated AGENTS.md.
